acceptedImplementation.note: M5A/M5B COMPLETE; M5C IMPLEMENTED (live workflow/UI). Pure domain (M5A + hardening): prediction lifecycle + immutable deep-frozen locking (canonical lockPrediction shared by create and reconstruct), ACTIVE decision trace + SHADOW audit in the lock (shadow never influences active), WIN/LOSS/PUSH/SKIPPED/INVALIDATED evaluation, engine-vs-played three-win trackers across 3 profiles, history-revision invalidation, fixed-unit paper, serialize/reconstruct. Persistence (M5B, DB-002): additive forward-only migration adds session_state (per-shoe workflow/cursor + paper cache) and locked_prediction_entries (immutable lock JSON payload + queryable lifecycle columns; partial-unique index WHERE invalidated=0 enforces one valid lock per shoe+target). SqliteSessionStore (native, authoritative) + MemorySessionStore (web AsyncStorage) share one contract with NO business logic; lock-before-result + transactional result submission + deterministic recovery of a missing pending lock. M5C wires the Active Shoe screen to the persisted session via useLiveSession + LiveSessionPanel: Start Live / Start Historical Test, persisted LOCKED prediction display (decision/confidence-score/category/risk), PLAYED-NOT_PLAYED operator control, actual P/T/B routed to the store (never a history append in a forward session), engine-vs-played progress + fixed-unit paper, and live-mode Review Data edit/delete routed through SessionStore.editHistory/deleteHistory (invalidation + renumber + rebuild) with the raw-round views (roadmap/stats/review list) sourced from the authoritative live session. Native fail-safe: createSessionStore throws SessionPersistenceUnavailableError if SQLite/DB-002 cannot init (NEVER silently downgrades to a volatile store); actual-result input is disabled unless a healthy store + valid persisted lock exist. Authority: raw rounds + revisions (DB-001) = baccarat history; locked_prediction_entries = engine-decision audit; sequences + paper = DERIVED; session_state = cursor only. Historical Matcher DISABLED; Volatility & Derived Road SHADOW_ONLY. Milestone 1-4 accepted code UNCHANGED; DB-001 + DB-002 schema UNCHANGED this task.
